No Loan Policy line appeared despite the $400,000 loan amount entered.
methodology: Driven via plain HTTP POST (Python requests.Session(), not WebFetch -- WebFetch's HTML-to-markdown conversion strips the raw hidden ASP.NET fields needed to replay the postback) against the classic __doPostBack/__VIEWSTATE WebForms flow, replaying the recipe already on file in this project's CALCULATORS.md (FNF family section) and previously used for CT/CO/AR: (1) GET ?ID=FNF&state=MS to capture hidden __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION fields and the county dropdown; (2) POST the county selection (own __EVENTTARGET); (3) POST the tool's own pre-selected default underwriter plus btnGeneralNext=Next to advance to the Amounts step; (4) POST TranType$ddl=PropertyPurchase (own __EVENTTARGET) to reveal the Purchase Amount field; (5) POST AmountPurchase$txt=500000 and AmountLoan1$txt=400000 together (own __EVENTTARGET on the loan field) to reveal any further conditional questions; (6) auto-answered any newly-revealed required Yes/No radio question with its first listed option, then POST btnFinish=Finish for the final Rate Summary. No personal data fields exist anywhere in this flow (only county/underwriter/transaction-type/dollar-amount fields).
